limitations: GLB materials approximate Unity shaders. Every original material texture slot and source bundle is preserved.
GLBs contain rest pose geometry and skins. Native controller/clip links are preserved separately, not baked into GLB animations.
Furniture candidates include original chair/isu/desk matching plus bench/table/bed/sofa/stool names; map associations remain necessary for choosing a chair/desk for a scene.
Viewer object rendering is not implemented by this extraction.
previewNotes: Original shaders are preserved; GLB uses an approximate PBR material.
Native object colliders and scripts are preserved, but GLB does not implement Unity physics.
Invisible placement/helper roots intentionally have no GLB.
Furniture count is map instances, not unique furniture designs.
